moved.title: Switch to the new Tigo cloud integration
moved.description:
This legacy integration is replaced by the new Tigo cloud integration, which supports several systems. It takes over your system, and its sensors keep their entity ids, history and statistics.

Install Tigo cloud {version} or later via HACS (repository MartinStoffel/tigo_cloud) and restart Home Assistant, then confirm the discovered Tigo system under Settings → Devices & services. Afterwards remove this integration from HACS.
